# Isabella Barroso

> Brazilian program and project manager based in Lisbon, Portugal, with 10 years of experience delivering grant-funded programs, grantmaking, partnerships and open-source projects. Currently Senior Project Manager at The Tor Project. Seeking program manager, project manager, program lead or delivery roles in climate and environmental work.

- Location: Lisbon, Portugal. Open to remote (Europe or worldwide) and Lisbon-based roles.
- Languages: Portuguese (native), English (fluent), Spanish (working proficiency).
- Focus areas: climate tech and open data; nature-based solutions and regeneration; climate justice and grassroots funding; sustainability programs and partnerships.
- Strengths: program delivery (workplans, milestones, risk), grantmaking and grantee management, budgets and budget narratives, funder reporting (including Sida), partnerships across 15+ countries, agile and product management.
- Contact: isabellabarroso@gmail.com
